rubric_markdown:
GRADER INSTRUCTIONS — C4 (Cross-Document Consistency (MSA + SOW)) · Max /12 · Gates: Faithfulness
ROLE: Grade the model's response against this gold rubric. Do NOT solve the task yourself. For every sub-judgment, quote the exact span of the response you relied on; a judgment with no quotable evidence scores 0. Return structured JSON per the Tier 1 template (Section 6.5). Never show this block to the model.
SOURCE OF TRUTH: Two related documents (an MSA and a SOW under it) with planted cross-document conflicts; grade findings against both documents as printed; a conflict requires support in BOTH documents' text.
SCORING (v8 — weighted ratio): each dimension score = Σ(weight×verdict)/Σ(weight), weights critical=3/major=2/minor=1, verdict met=1/partial=0.5/not_met=0/n-a=excluded. Assign a verdict to EACH listed criterion; never assign the dimension number yourself.
FAITHFULNESS /3 (GATE): criteria — [critical] Each asserted conflict quotes BOTH documents' actual language (no invented conflict, no misquote). TRIPS ONLY ON: Inventing a conflict not supported by both documents' text; Misquoting either document. DOES NOT TRIP ON: A correct cross-reference between the two documents.
COVERAGE /4: criteria — [critical, C4.conflict.payment_terms] Identifies the payment-terms conflict between the documents; [critical, C4.conflict.ip_ownership] Identifies the IP-ownership conflict; [minor, C4.conflict.termination] Identifies the termination/precedence conflict.
SOUNDNESS /3: criteria — [critical] Correctly explains which document governs / why each conflict matters; does NOT flag non-conflicts.
ACTIONABILITY /2: criteria — [critical] Organized by conflict; each: the inconsistency + the resolution question.
DISCRETION VALVE (v8): if a response is not addressed by the enumerated gate conditions, return verdict not_covered on that gate (routes to human-confirm) + a proposed_condition stating the rule that would resolve it — do NOT guess trip/pass.
PROCEDURE: assign a verdict to every criterion → weighted ratio per dimension → raw = Σ max(dim)×ratio → normalize to /12 → if ANY gate tripped, cap the normalized score at 0.40 and flag it.
